siteNavigation: Accessible name of the header navigation landmark.
visitMainPage: Accessible name of the Wikipedia wordmark link in the header.
wordmarkAlt: Alt text of the Wikipedia wordmark image.
search: Header search button (icon label and desktop submit button).
notices: Header tray icon for notices (Echo), as opposed to alerts.
appearance: Header button opening appearance settings (text size, theme).
home: Button returning to the prototype Home page.
userPage: User menu item linking to the user’s own user page.
talk: Talk page (user menu item, and the article’s talk tab).
sandbox: User menu item: the user’s personal sandbox page.
translations: User menu item: the user’s Content Translation dashboard.
uploadedMedia: User menu item: media files the user uploaded.
saved: User menu item: the user’s saved (bookmarked) articles.
clearLocalStorage: Main menu item that clears the prototype’s saved browser data and reloads.
footerLastEditedDesktop: Mock footer notice; the date is fixed placeholder text.
footerLicense: Desktop footer license notice. $1 = link {{msg|chrome-footerLicenseName}}, $2 = link {{msg|chrome-footerLicenseTermsOfUse}}, $3 = link {{msg|chrome-footerLicensePrivacyPolicy}}. The space before ";" in English is intentional (it matches the existing rendering); translators should follow their own punctuation rules.
footerLicenseTitle: Tooltip (title attribute) of the license link.
footerPrototypeCredit: Footer credit line. "ProtoWiki" is the name of the prototyping tool; do not translate.
footerLegalContacts: Footer link to the Wikimedia Foundation legal and safety contact information.
footerCodeOfConduct: Footer link to the Universal Code of Conduct.
footerDesktopView: Mobile footer link switching to the desktop site.
footerMobileView: Desktop footer link switching to the mobile site.
footerLastEditedMobile: Mock mobile footer strip. $1 = username (rendered bold). The elapsed time is fixed placeholder text.
footerUsernamePlaceholder: Placeholder username shown in {{msg|chrome-footerLastEditedMobile}} when the prototype supplies none.
articleTab: Page tab for the article itself (next to {{msg|chrome-talk}}).
watch: Page action: add the page to the watchlist.
bookmark: Page action: save the article to read later.
download: Page action: download the article as PDF.
pageTabs: Accessible name of the Article / Talk tab list.
pageActions: Accessible name of the page action toolbar.
languages: Accessible name of the interlanguage-links button.
languagesCount: Interlanguage-links button. $1 = number of other languages the article is available in.
